Under unique minimum the normalizer acts by a signed permutation on these pairs. value.rationale: The object is the canonical rank filtration of uniform matroids, considered under arbitrary finite permutation-group fixed loci. The result determines all integral persistent groups and inclusion maps for all orbit-weight profiles in one infinite-family formula, reveals the rigid bar length equal to the smallest orbit, and supplies an explicit normalizer-equivariant signed permutation integral lattice whenever that minimum is unique. This goes substantively beyond fixed-level Betti values and is a natural complete equivariant classification.
